name: gelpy
description: Analyze gel electrophoresis images end-to-end with the gelpy CLI: place lanes from the image itself, remove background, fit per-lane band intensities, and produce a browsable run folder with results.csv, a report, and per-lane fit plots. Encodes the verify-as-you-go loop -- detect lanes, confirm the overlay, fit, inspect every lane, refit the stragglers.
